description.id: Panduan umum salat Idulfitri dan Iduladha. Jumlah takbir tambahan dan rincian pelaksanaan dapat berbeda menurut mazhab.
description.en: A general guide to Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha prayer. The number of additional takbirs and details may differ by school.

description.id: Ikuti pengumuman hari raya dan jadwal salat dari otoritas setempat.
description.en: Follow local authority announcements for the Eid date and prayer time.

translation.id: Bersuci, berpakaian pantas, dan datang ke tempat salat dengan tertib. Waktu salat Id dimulai setelah matahari naik dan mengikuti jadwal masjid atau otoritas setempat. Perhatikan aturan akses dan keselamatan.
translation.en: Perform purification, dress appropriately, and arrive at the prayer place in an orderly manner. Eid prayer begins after sunrise and follows the local mosque or authority's schedule. Observe access and safety rules.

description.id: Salat Id umumnya dilakukan dua rakaat dengan takbir tambahan.
description.en: Eid prayer is generally two rak'ahs with additional takbirs.

translation.id: Ikuti gerakan imam. Jumlah dan posisi takbir tambahan berbeda menurut mazhab; jangan mendahului imam dan ikuti tata cara yang diumumkan. Bila datang terlambat atau tertinggal rakaat, tanyakan kepada imam atau pembimbing mengenai cara menyempurnakannya.
translation.en: Follow the imam's movements. The number and placement of additional takbirs differ by school; do not precede the imam and follow the announced method. If late or missing a rak'ah, ask the imam or a guide how to complete it.

description.id: Dengarkan khutbah dan jaga ketertiban serta kenyamanan jamaah.
description.en: Listen to the sermon and maintain order and consideration for others.

translation.id: Khutbah Id disampaikan setelah salat menurut praktik yang umum. Dengarkan dengan tenang, jaga kebersihan, beri ruang bagi jamaah lain, dan ikuti pengaturan lokasi.
translation.en: The Eid sermon is commonly delivered after the prayer. Listen calmly, keep the area clean, make room for others, and follow venue arrangements.
